summary.result: The experimental results showed that automated geo-positioning approach can be accomplished more effectively by using NGII DEM with higher resolution than SRTM DEM.
summary.background: S The need for an automated geo-positioning approach for near real-time results and to boost cost-effectiveness has become increasingly urgent.
summary.method: The core idea of this approach is to remove the bias of RFM only using tie points, which are corrected by matching with the digital elevation model (DEM) without any additional ground control points (GCPs).

summary_ko.method: 이 방법의 핵심은 RFM의 편향을 제거하기 위해 키 포인트만을 사용하여, 추가적인 지면 통제점(GCPs) 없이 디지털 고도모형(DEM)과 매칭을 통해 보정하는 것이다.
